subject: Application for Virtual Administrative Assistant
paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Virtual Administrative Assistant position at Insight Admin. With experience as a counsellor and office administrator, alongside reception and customer care, I would welcome the opportunity to help your practitioners focus on client care through organised, dependable administrative support.

At Ahadi Counselling Center, I provided counselling and therapeutic support to 47 clients during my role, typically seeing around four to five clients a day. Supporting people experiencing mental-health and substance-use challenges strengthened my understanding of empathetic communication, client dignity and privacy. I enjoy listening to people and helping them feel supported and valued, and would bring that same warmth and professionalism to your practitioners and their clients.

In my current office administration role at BTI Global, which I joined in March 2026, I track shipments and coordinate client onboarding, travel and site visits across international operations. I also spent a week in Rwanda helping establish an office and train personnel. These responsibilities have strengthened my organisation, initiative and ability to coordinate practical details across competing priorities.

My reception experience at Janique Nail Parlour included managing appointments, responding to enquiries, processing payments and maintaining daily records. At CCI Global Kenya, I handled enquiries and follow-ups, updated CRM records accurately and resolved complaints calmly. Together, these roles have given me practical skills in scheduling, record-keeping and responsive client communication.

I am reliable and quick to learn, with experience using Microsoft Office, email, CRM systems and in-house administrative software. I have a dedicated home office equipped for client calls, video meetings and remote administration, and I am keen to learn Halaxy and your practice workflows.

What draws me to Insight Admin is the opportunity to combine my administrative experience with my interest in mental health, while growing with your business. I would be proud to contribute to the day-to-day organisation that helps practices run smoothly and clients receive a warm, respectful response.
Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience, commitment to service and willingness to learn could support Insight Admin.
